description: A disk cache and Parquet archive for Databento.CSharpApiClient, so each day of Databento data is paid for once. The client's time-series calls served from per-symbol UTC day files, batch jobs for large ranges, a compactor that folds day files into Parquet any reader can query, and backup and restore of the whole cache.
releaseNotes:
v1.3.0 - 2026-11-25

Added
- Databento's metadata and symbology calls on the cached client, passed through uncached: ListDatasets,
  ListSchemas, ListPublishers, ListFields, ListUnitPrices, GetDatasetCondition, GetDatasetRange, ListConditions,
  GetRecordCount, GetBillableSize, GetCost and ResolveSymbols, so one client serves the whole Historical API.
  Async on ICachedDatabentoClient, with default implementations that throw NotSupportedException; their
  synchronous forms are in CachedDatabentoClientExtensions.

Changed
- Built on Databento.CSharpApiClient 2.7.1.
- The DBN client is created only when Transport is Dbn; with the default Json it held an unused one.

v1.2.0 - 2026-11-25

Added
- CacheMode.CacheOnly: serves what the cache holds and downloads nothing, so a call never costs anything. When
  the cache lacks a symbol-day of the range, the call throws NotCachedException naming them, and asks Databento
  nothing. For a restored backup used as it is, or a host that must not reach Databento for a while.

v1.1.0 - 2026-11-25

Added
- ICachedDatabentoClient, which CachedDatabentoClient implements: the time-series calls with a CacheMode, the
  batch calls and the ArchiveFileUnreadable event, so code can be handed a fake in tests. An implementation
  writes only the 11 async calls for several symbols; CachedDatabentoClientExtensions adds the one-symbol and
  sync forms.
- CachedDatabentoClient is an IDatabentoTimeseriesClient (client 2.7.0) and serves its calls from the cache
  (CacheMode.Use), so code that takes either Databento client takes the cache too. The cache still refuses
  ALL_SYMBOLS: it needs the raw symbols.

Changed
- Built on Databento.CSharpApiClient 2.7.0 (it was 2.6.0).

v1.0.0 - 2026-11-24

First release.
- CachedDatabentoClient: the client's time-series calls for cbbo-1s, cbbo-1m, bbo-1s, bbo-1m, tcbbo, trades,
  ohlcv-1s/1m/1h/1d and statistics, async and sync, served per symbol and UTC day from the cache, else
  downloaded whole, and saved before the call returns once Databento says the day is final. JSON or DBN
  transport, a Bypass mode that downloads again, and empty days saved only when symbology confirms the symbol
  was not listed (by default).
- Batch jobs for ranges too large for the time-series calls, with a cost cap and reuse of a job that already
  covers the range; any Databento batch download folder can be ingested too.
- DatabentoArchiveCompactor: folds day files into one Parquet archive per dataset, schema, group and month,
  checked record by record (by default) before the files it replaces are deleted.
- DatabentoCacheBackup and DatabentoCacheRestore: the whole cache as one checked tar in an IBackupStore, with
  retention, a dry run, and a restore that refuses while the cache is in use.

Full history: https://github.com/mrut2pac/Databento.CSharpApiClient.Caching/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
